# Rillio

> Rillio is a pre-launch personal-finance app by AI AZIMARA: small habits,
> stronger financial futures. It connects real imported spending data,
> deterministic cash-flow insight, honest savings planning and read-only
> portfolio visibility — and never holds your money. In development at Rillio.

## What it is

- Real imported spending data in, deterministic insight out: cash-flow
  patterns and savings targets are computed, not guessed.
- Savings plans are plans, not deposits — Rillio does not hold, move or
  custody funds.
- On-chain read-only visibility (Solana) so a user can see ownership without
  granting transactions.

## What it is not

- Not a bank, not a brokerage, not a payment gateway, not a custodian.
- Not financial advice; insight is deterministic arithmetic on the user's own
  imported data.
- Pre-launch: no domain assigned yet; nothing here is live, published or
  accepting users.

## Group

Rillio is an AI AZIMARA group product. The group is headquartered at the
Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, United
Arab Emirates.

- AI AZIMARA portfolio: https://aiazimara.com/portfolio/
